sections.executive_summary: This report covers the compliance audit results for Q2 2026.
sections.methodology: We used a risk-based approach to assess controls across all domains.
sections.findings: Three critical findings were identified: missing MFA on admin accounts, outdated TLS certificates, and lack of audit logging.
sections.recommendations: 1. Enforce MFA on all admin accounts within 30 days. 2. Update TLS certificates before expiry. 3. Implement centralized audit logging.
sections.signatures: Approved by: John Doe (CISO), Jane Smith (Audit Lead), Date: 2026-06-20
